_comment: Permanent redirects served by the CloudFront viewer-request function. Each `from` is matched exactly; `to` is site-relative and may carry a fragment. The target must be live before the redirect is published. Every row here belongs to a withdrawal and points at its corrections entry: five for the Real Bot note, six for the bug-bounty note (its address and its old /blog/ alias, three forms each). scripts/stamp-withdrawal.sh dates a withdrawal's rows on the day its record ships and checks them on every build. Keep each row on one line: the script reads the table line by line. The deploy workflow refuses to publish while any row still carries an undated target.
